notes.claim: The logarithm of a product is the sum of the logs of its factors.
In the log system multiplication becomes addition and division subtraction, and powers become multiplication, which is why decibel gains of stages add.

sources.title: Intro to logarithm properties (article) | Khan Academy
sources.quote: This property says that the logarithm of a product is the sum of the logs of its factors.

sources.title: 1.2: The Decibel - Engineering LibreTexts
sources.quote: Normal multiplication becomes addition in the log system, and division becomes subtraction. Likewise, powers and roots become multiplication and division.
